description: B-11 (#3804) macro per-phase wall-clock baseline for the B-7 golden corpus gate. Complements the B-12 graph/query snapshot (e2e-20repo-snapshot.json): the snapshot is the logic contract, this is the performance contract. The golden-corpus-gate compares each live run's phase-timings.json against these numbers and fails a gated phase that regresses beyond the band, OR keeps it advisory on shared CI runners (see regression_policy).

collect.note: cassette replay + the collector settle poll (waits until every credentialed collector's cassette has fully replayed -- both the distinct-source count reaches GATE_MIN_COLLECTOR_SOURCES and the total landed-scope count reaches GATE_EXPECTED_TOTAL_SCOPES -- bounded by the GATE_COLLECTOR_SETTLE_SECONDS deadline) + facts-landed verification. Dominated by how long fact commit actually takes on this run, not a fixed constant, so it is recorded for visibility but not gated.

first_drain.note: first projector+reducer drain to terminal. Recaptured for #4637: the 6s seed was stale (main's real first_drain had been ~65-68s for some time, tripping the advisory every run). Measured 75s on the golden gate at commit 62147d83e (all three #3624 cold-ingest fixes merged: #4728 graph-write budget, #4732 Helm retract skip, #4734 ingester gate). The +~9s vs the pre-fix ~66s is the #4728 in-flight budget pacing writes on the small 20-repo cassette, which does not saturate the throughput knee — a bounded tradeoff (operator-tunable via ESHU_GRAPH_WRITE_MAX_IN_FLIGHT) that prevents the concurrency-saturation failure cascade at full-corpus scale. Not a masked regression: this is the current legitimate steady-state. The 0.15 band + 5s slack absorb run-to-run laptop jitter.

maintenance_drains.note: three deferred maintenance + drain cycles (#5426). The chain container_image_identity -> ci_cd_run_correlation -> supply_chain_impact is three links reopened concurrently, and two cycles converged with zero margin: measured, at one pass the required environment_evidence assertion fails and at two it passes. Re-baselined 14 -> 25s after exact then-main 06add5ff9 measured 25s on the enforcement host, corroborating the accepted #5770 capture at 25s; the 14s seed no longer represented main and warned before the #5704 fixture change was present. After #5936 merged, exact current main 9f149334 measured 28s, within the recaptured baseline's existing 30s ceiling. The +5s absolute slack permits 30s on this host. refresh-e2e-baseline.sh preserves this note, so update it by hand when the cycle count changes. The additive-correlation convergence long pole at full corpus scale.

graph_query.note: eshu-api + eshu-mcp-server startup before the assertion phase (excludes the gate's own assertion time). #5837: assertion work that runs BETWEEN the phase's start and end stamps must be bracketed by the orchestrator (phase_graph_query_excluded_starts/_ends, one matching-index pair per bracket, summed -- #5837 P2-8/156c8d2d1) so it is subtracted, not billed to startup. #5465's suppression producer proof is the first such block, and it floors itself at 20s via its own expiry wait -- above this phase's 8s effective ceiling (3s baseline + 5s absolute_slack_seconds) on any host, provable from source without a measurement. (The ~23s figure quoted elsewhere for this phase is an illustrative local reading, not a captured one.) Bracket any future in-window proof the same way rather than widening this number.

regression_policy.rule: A gated phase passes if observed_seconds <= baseline_seconds * (1 + regression_band) OR observed_seconds <= baseline_seconds + absolute_slack_seconds.
regression_policy.ci_mode: The golden-corpus-gate workflow runs the per-phase check in ADVISORY mode (-phase-regression-advisory) because GitHub's shared runners vary run-to-run by more than the band — the same reasoning behind the gate's 2x total-wall-time budget multiplier. Per-PR regressions stay visible without false reds.
regression_policy.blocking_mode: A controlled validation host (consistent hardware) runs with GATE_PHASE_REGRESSION_ADVISORY=false to make the gated phases blocking, where the baseline below is valid.

capture.host_class: developer laptop (apple silicon, arm64), local docker compose
capture.note: Seed capture. Integer-second resolution (date +%s, portable across GNU/BSD); the absolute_slack_seconds allowance absorbs the resulting jitter on small phases. Recapture on the enforcement host for blocking use.

update_protocol.when: Update when an intentional perf change alters a phase's wall-clock, or when recapturing on a new enforcement host. Do not update in response to transient CI noise (that is what the band + slack absorb).
update_protocol.how: Run scripts/refresh-e2e-baseline.sh on the enforcement host, review the diff, and commit with a clear before/after explanation in the PR.
update_protocol.who: Baseline updates require the same review bar as code changes. Silently widening numbers to mask a regression is not acceptable.
